component.$description: Layer 3 - Component: tokens scoped to a specific UI component, composed exclusively from semantic tokens. Atoms: button, icon-button, input, checkbox, radio, switch, badge, avatar, tooltip, link, divider, progress, skeleton. Layout: app-shell, sidebar, topbar, page, card, stat-card, table, tabs, segmented-control, dropdown, modal, alert, chart.

button.$description: Atom - Button. Consumes only semantic tokens.

size.$description: Padding, min-height, font and icon size per button size.

color.$description: Color per variant and state. Primary = light orange, secondary = light purple, both with dark text.

shadow.$description: Elevation of filled and outline variants: raised at rest, lifted on hover, flat when pressed or disabled.

icon-button.$description: Atom - Icon-only button (toolbar, table row actions, topbar). Square; reuses button.color variants.

input.$description: Atom - Text input / select / textarea / search field.

checkbox.$description: Atom - Checkbox. Checked fill uses brand.primary-strong (>= 3:1 on white) with a dark check mark.

radio.$description: Atom - Radio. Same palette as checkbox; indicator is the inner dot.

size.$description: Switch.IconOn / Switch.IconOff, drawn inside the thumb.

badge.$description: Atom - Badge / status pill / tag (table status, counts, filters).

size.$description: Height, inline padding and type per badge/tag size.

avatar.$description: Atom - Avatar (user menu, table owner column).

tooltip.$description: Atom - Tooltip (chart hovers, truncated labels, icon buttons).

divider.$description: Atom - Divider. Line thickness and color per emphasis.

skeleton.$description: Atom - Loading skeleton for cards, charts and table rows.

app-shell.$description: Layout - App shell: sidebar + topbar + scrollable content region.

sidebar.$description: Layout - Sidebar navigation (light). Active item = light-orange tint + orange indicator bar.

topbar.$description: Layout - Top app bar (page title, search, notifications, user menu).

page.$description: Layout - Page / content region inside the shell.

card.$description: Layout - Card: container for charts, lists and widgets.

stat-card.$description: Layout - KPI / stat card: label, big value, trend delta, optional icon tile.

tabs.$description: Layout - Tabs (switch dashboard views / time ranges).

dropdown.$description: Layout - Dropdown menu / popover (filters, user menu).

popover.$description: Molecule - Popover: non-modal floating panel anchored to a trigger.

offset.$description: Distance between the trigger and the popup.

chart.$description: Layout - Chart container inside a card.
